## Workflow map

CVD event Steps 1–3 create the private extract, confidential cumulative dataset and deidentified analytical inputs. Steps 4–6 calculate, review, approve and publish the combined metric package.

```text
REDCap extract
  -> frozen history + current records
  -> purpose-specific private inputs
  -> burden + mortality-linked/DCO calculations
  -> disclosure review and approval
  -> authoritative public package + website mirror
```

| Step | Controller | Guide |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Extract REDCap | `monthly/bnr_step1_cvd_redcap_extract.do` | [Extract a REDCap release](extract-redcap.qmd) |
| 2. Build cumulative data | `monthly/bnr_step2_cvd_confidential.do` | [Prepare the confidential dataset](prepare-confidential.qmd) |
| 3. Build deidentified inputs | `monthly/bnr_step3_metric_inputs.do` | [Create analytical inputs](create-analysis-inputs.qmd) |
| 4. Calculate dashboard metrics | `monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do` | [Generate combined CVD metrics](generate-metrics.qmd) |
| 5. Review and approve | `monthly/bnr_step5_review.do` | [Review and approve](review-approve.qmd) |
| 6. Publish approved outputs | `monthly/bnr_step6_publish.do` | [Publish metrics](publish-metrics.qmd) |

All Steps 1–5 material remains private. Step 6 alone crosses the private-to-public boundary. Dashboards, tables, downloads and standard reports consume the approved public release; they do not repeat the analysis.

For the team-facing procedure, see [Operations: run the CVD event release workflow](../../../operations/post-redcap/cvd-events-workflow.qmd).
